data.notes: December 2026 in Los Angeles is already anchored by arena pop/R&B, regional Mexican concerts, and a strong warehouse/club calendar across house, techno, jungle, and disco.

events.title: Stevie Wonder
events.summary: Stevie Wonder plays Intuit Dome on December 19 at 8:00 PM. The venue's official event page confirms the date at the Inglewood arena.

events.title: John Summit - CTRL Escape Tour
events.summary: John Summit headlines Los Angeles Memorial Coliseum on December 12 with his CTRL Escape Tour. Insomniac confirms the all-ages tech-house event with doors at 6:00 PM and show time at 7:30 PM.

events.title: 102.7 KIIS FM's Jingle Ball Presented by Capital One
events.summary: KIIS FM's annual Jingle Ball lands at Intuit Dome on December 4. The confirmed event page lists the show for 7:30 PM at the Inglewood arena.

events.title: TYLA - THE A*POP WORLD TOUR
events.summary: Tyla brings THE A*POP WORLD TOUR to YouTube Theater on December 16. The venue confirms the 8:00 PM show and frames the tour around her South African-rooted global pop sound.

events.title: Victoria Monét - Frequency Of Love Tour
events.summary: Victoria Monét brings the Frequency Of Love Tour to YouTube Theater on December 8. The venue confirms the 8:00 PM concert and describes Monét as a Grammy-winning R&B/pop artist.

events.title: WORK presents 999999999 Invites: 999999999, Annika Wolfe, Boston 168 [Live] & Kaiser
events.summary: A high-impact acid and industrial techno warehouse night from WORK with 999999999, Annika Wolfe, Boston 168 live, Kaiser and a light installation by Ausgang Studio.

events.title: The Neighbourhood
events.summary: The Southern California alt-pop band plays Kia Forum in Inglewood on December 4 at 7:00 PM. AXS lists the show as a confirmed event at the venue.

events.title: Thundercat: Distracted AF Tour
events.summary: Los Angeles bassist and producer Thundercat headlines the Hollywood Palladium on December 5. Ticketmaster lists the Distracted AF Tour date for 7:00 PM.

events.title: INCOGNITO x Metalheadz: Goldie, Photek, DRS, Diverge
events.summary: INCOGNITO and Metalheadz present a heavyweight drum & bass and jungle night with Goldie, Photek, DRS, and Diverge. Resident Advisor confirms the December 11 warehouse event in Los Angeles.

events.title: Earl Sweatshirt & MIKE - Home on the Range Tour 2026
events.summary: Earl Sweatshirt and MIKE bring the Home on the Range Tour to the Hollywood Palladium on December 19. Ticketmaster confirms the hip-hop bill at 7:00 PM.

events.title: TUNNEL 5YR: Special Guest (Berghain), ROZA Terenzi, DJ Warning & OZA
events.summary: TUNNEL celebrates five years with a techno and house lineup including ROZA Terenzi, DJ Warning, OZA, and a special Berghain guest. Resident Advisor confirms the December 5 warehouse-style event in Los Angeles.

events.title: R&B ONLY LIVE - Los Angeles
events.summary: R&B ONLY LIVE takes over the Hollywood Palladium for a DJ-led night of classic and modern R&B. The official event page lists the Los Angeles edition for December 12 from 8:00 PM to 1:00 AM.

events.title: Los Gemelos de Sinaloa - The Gemeliza Tour
events.summary: Los Gemelos de Sinaloa bring The Gemeliza Tour to YouTube Theater on December 12. The venue announcement notes the Paramount-born duo's return to touring and their role in the modern corridos wave.

events.title: I LOVE DNB: Kings of the Rollers
events.summary: I LOVE DNB takes over The Beehive’s 15,000-square-foot Depot warehouse with Kings of the Rollers, Turno, Sub Killaz, LMNOP and Maylay.

events.title: WORK Harder presents: Rebekah All Night Long
events.summary: WORK Harder hosts UK techno artist Rebekah for an all-night-long set at a TBA Los Angeles location. Resident Advisor lists the event for Friday, December 4 with RA tickets.

events.title: Alicia Villarreal - Bendita Locura Tour 2026
events.summary: Alicia Villarreal brings her Bendita Locura Tour to YouTube Theater on December 5. The venue lists the show at 8:00 PM with tickets on sale.

events.title: Into The Woods presents Dusky
events.summary: Into The Woods brings UK duo Dusky to a TBA Los Angeles location on December 12. Resident Advisor lists the event as a 21+ house and bass night.

events.title: Avalon presents Oden & Fatzo
events.summary: Avalon Hollywood hosts French electronic act Oden & Fatzo on December 5 at 10:00 PM. The venue page confirms the 21+ event at 1735 Vine Street.

events.title: The Neighbourhood: THE WOURLD TOUR
events.summary: A second confirmed Kia Forum date for The Neighbourhood’s THE WOURLD TOUR, scheduled for Saturday, December 5, 2026.

events.title: Book of Love
events.summary: Synth-pop group Book of Love play Teragram Ballroom with all four original band members noted for the VIP meet-and-greet package.

events.title: The Pineapple Thief: Far and Wide Tour 2026
events.summary: The Pineapple Thief bring their Far and Wide Tour 2026 to The Bellwether, with the venue listing doors at 7:00 pm and show at 8:00 pm.
